17188252.inGameDescription: After picking up an Orb of Power, the next time your shields are broken, gain a bonus to Health stat for a short duration and release a burst of radiolaria around you.

17188253.name: Atheon's Memory (4 pc): Collective Power
17188253.inGameDescription: While you have a subclass buff, dealing sustained damage creates an Orb of Power.

109046536.name: Sage Protector (4 pc): Blade Focus
109046536.inGameDescription: Briefly guard with a Sword to ready Blade Focus. While Blade Focus is readied, hitting a target with your sword increases Sword damage and lunge distance for a moderate duration.

109046537.name: Sage Protector (2 pc): Combat Meditation
109046537.inGameDescription: Sword hits return grenade and class energy. Bonus energy is granted if Blade Focus is active.

219133236.name: Shrewd Survivor (2 pc): Reflex Action
219133236.inGameDescription: Swapping to a Heat weapon, Submachine Gun, or Hand Cannon grants a short period of increased handling and accuracy. This effect is extended by dealing damage with that weapon.

219133237.name: Shrewd Survivor (4 pc): Hotshot
219133237.inGameDescription: Dealing final blows while Reflex Action is active grants a bonus to weapon stat and increases stability, reload, and aim assist for Heat weapons, Submachine Guns, and Hand Cannons for a moderate duration.

446332292.name: TM Custom (2 pc): Old Martian Diplomacy
446332292.inGameDescription: Stowing a weapon after defeating a powerful combatant or a Guardian heals you a small amount and disorients nearby combatants.

446332293.name: TM Custom (4 pc): High Noon
446332293.inGameDescription: Freshly drawn weapons deal increased precision damage to combatants for a short period. Weapons with the Tex Balanced Stock Origin Trait equipped or Exotics manufactured by the Tex Mechanica Foundry gain further increased benefits.

627214276.name: Spacewalk (2 pc): Augmented Armaments
627214276.inGameDescription: Primary ammo weapons deal increased damage to disoriented combatants.

627214277.name: Spacewalk (4 pc): Augmented Explosives
627214277.inGameDescription: Your grenade abilities release an additional disorienting pulse shortly after detonating.

681117218.name: Thriving Survivor (2 pc): Opening Act
681117218.inGameDescription: Final blows with grenades grant Heat weapons bonus stability and vent speed and grant Primary ammo weapons bonus stability and reload speed.

681117219.name: Thriving Survivor (4 pc): Room Clearing
681117219.inGameDescription: Multiple final blows with Heat weapons or Primary ammo weapons grant bonuses to weapon and grenade stats and increased ammo generation for Heat weapons and Primary ammo weapons.

696050396.name: Apostate's Blade (4 pc): Melee Conduction
696050396.inGameDescription: While you have Radiant, Restoration, or Cure, your melee hits release a burst that will scorch the target.

696050397.name: Apostate's Blade (2 pc): Regenerative Threshold
696050397.inGameDescription: Performing a finisher stores power. The next time your shields are broken, consume stored power to immediately heal and start health regeneration.

705026902.name: Promised (4 pc): Resonance Redirection
705026902.inGameDescription: While you have Stable Resonance, continued weapon damage occasionally generates a resonance burst that damages and exhausts targets.

705026903.name: Promised (2 pc): Stable Resonance
705026903.inGameDescription: Defeating a powerful combatant generates Stable Resonance, which grants damage resistance and increased weapon damage for the duration.

754620348.name: Flain (4 pc): Knit Together
754620348.inGameDescription: For a short time after your shields break, your next several Threadling hits restore health.

754620349.name: Flain (2 pc): Sinew Stitching
754620349.inGameDescription: Taking damage from combatants sometimes spawns a Threadling.

793561548.name: Crystocrene (2 pc): Resupply
793561548.inGameDescription: After being out of combat for a moderate duration, your next final blow grants additional ammo progress and creates an Orb of Power.

793561549.name: Crystocrene (4 pc): From the Storm
793561549.inGameDescription: After being out of combat for a moderate duration, slowly gain Frost Armor until you reenter combat.

846599598.name: Oryx's Memory (4 pc): Ascendant Escape
846599598.inGameDescription: After a final blow on a powerful combatant, the next time your shields are broken, you become invisible.

846599599.name: Oryx's Memory (2 pc): Iron Sharpens Iron
846599599.inGameDescription: Final blows on Guardians and powerful combatants generate additional ammo progress.

1010623576.name: Resonant Fury (4 pc): Siphoning Touch
1010623576.inGameDescription: Gain stacks of Siphoning Touch for weapon or Glaive melee hits. Switching weapons heals you and consumes all stacks.

1010623577.name: Resonant Fury (2 pc): Resonant Plating
1010623577.inGameDescription: Your health begins regenerating immediately after taking melee damage from a powerful combatant.

1025384966.name: Twofold Crown (2 pc): Crook and Flail
1025384966.inGameDescription: Picking up an ammo brick heals you.

1025384967.name: Twofold Crown (4 pc): Gift of Sight
1025384967.inGameDescription: Final blows with Primary ammo weapons grant you briefly increased radar resolution.

1076851134.name: Exodus Down (4 pc): Repurposed Charge
1076851134.inGameDescription:
Whenever you gain, lose, or spend an Armor Charge, heal and gain damage reduction for a short time.

This effect scales with the amount of Armor Charge gained, lost, or spent.

1076851135.name: Exodus Down (2 pc): Emergency Electromagnet
1076851135.inGameDescription: When your shields become broken, collect all nearby Orbs of Power and ammo bricks.

1130213040.name: Techsec (2 pc): Wrecker
1130213040.inGameDescription: You deal significantly increased Kinetic damage to combatant shields, overshields, vehicles, and constructs. Constructs include barricades, turrets, Stasis crystals, and other objects created in the field.

1130213041.name: Techsec (4 pc): Concussive Rounds
1130213041.inGameDescription: Defeating powerful combatants or breaking a combatant shield with Kinetic damage releases a disorienting Kinetic shockwave.

1246205950.name: Reverie Dawn (2 pc): A Wish for Protection
1246205950.inGameDescription: Taking significant damage in a short time generates a Protective Wish that makes it harder for combatants to hit you, and grants increased reload speed and flinch resistance.

1246205951.name: Reverie Dawn (4 pc): A Wish Fulfilled
1246205951.inGameDescription:
When the Protective Wish expires, it cures you. 

Rapid final blows prematurely end the Protective Wish.

1302582376.name: Veritas (4 pc): Lucent Tithes
1302582376.inGameDescription: Performing a finisher on powerful combatants heals you and generates loyal Void moths.

1302582377.name: Veritas (2 pc): Lucent Transmutation
1302582377.inGameDescription: Performing a finisher on a combatant, or landing successive powered melee final blows, generates an Elemental pickup based on your Light subclass.

1567556260.name: Nezarec's Nightmare (2 pc): Bad Dreams
1567556260.inGameDescription: Final blows versus subclass-debuffed targets have an escalating chance to spawn an Orb of Power.

1567556261.name: Nezarec's Nightmare (4 pc): Dream-Devourer
1567556261.inGameDescription: Performing a finisher versus a powerful combatant grants Devour. While you have Devour, gain damage resistance versus combatants.

1814176200.name: CODA (2 pc): Between Poles
1814176200.inGameDescription: Final blows with Light weapons grants stacks of Light Polarity, which grants Grenade stat. Final blows with Darkness or Kinetic weapons grants stacks of Dark Polarity, which grants stacks of Melee stat.

1814176201.name: CODA (4 pc): So Very Thin
1814176201.inGameDescription: Final blows with Light weapons grants additional grenade energy. Final blows with Dark or Kinetic weapons grants additional melee energy. Rapid final blows that alternate between Light and Darkness grant a short period of damage resistance.

1836665910.name: Taken King (4 pc): Lucent Swarm
1836665910.inGameDescription: Collecting Orbs of Power extends the Ceremony. While it is active, ability final blows occasionally spawn allied Arc moths.

1836665911.name: Taken King (2 pc): The Ceremony
1836665911.inGameDescription: Finishing combatants or reviving allies initiates a Lucent Hive ritual. While the ritual is active, gain increased Super stat.

1875006806.name: Deep Explorer (2 pc): Built Bitter
1875006806.inGameDescription: Taking damage increases the reload speed of your equipped weapon until it is stowed. Taking more damage increases the effect.

1875006807.name: Deep Explorer (4 pc): Bittersweet
1875006807.inGameDescription: When you stow a weapon, restore health based on the number of Built Bitter stacks lost.

1888882410.name: Collective Pugilism
1888882410.inGameDescription:
Collecting an Elemental pickup or destroying a Tangle grants this weapon a stacking period of melee energy generation on hit. Throwing a Tangle provides additional time.

Elemental pickups include [Solar]Firesprites, [Void]Void Breaches, [Arc]Ionic Traces, [Stasis]Stasis Shards, and [Strand]Strand Tangles.

1901305282.name: Collective Psyche (4 pc): Doppler Effect
1901305282.inGameDescription: Suspend, unravel, and sever effects applied to targets, and radiant and restoration effects applied to you have increased duration.

1901305283.name: Collective Psyche (2 pc): Accretion
1901305283.inGameDescription: Picking up an ammo brick gives you a stacking bonus to weapon swap and stow speeds until you die.

1964062928.name: Bushido (4 pc): Unfaltering Focus
1964062928.inGameDescription: Bow, Shotgun, or Sword final blows temporarily reduce incoming damage. Damaging targets with those weapons extends the effect.

1964062929.name: Bushido (2 pc): Iaido
1964062929.inGameDescription: Final blows with freshly drawn or reloaded weapons heal you.

2140508054.name: AION Renewal (4 pc): Reactive Booster
2140508054.inGameDescription: Once per activation of Force Converter, sprinting while at critical health, being suspended, or being slowed by a Stasis effect will immediately grant Speed Booster for a short duration.

2140508055.name: AION Renewal (2 pc): Force Converter
2140508055.inGameDescription: After a final blow with a Rocket Launcher, Grenade Launcher, or micro-missile, sprint for a short time to gain Speed Booster.

2162040230.name: Yearning Echo (2 pc): Untold Greed
2162040230.inGameDescription: Picking up ammo, Orbs of Power, Elemental pickups, or destroying a Strand Tangle grants stacks of Untold Greed, slightly reducing damage taken and providing reload speed to equipped weapons. When your shields are broken, some stacks are lost.

2162040231.name: Yearning Echo (4 pc): Overflowing Coffers
2162040231.inGameDescription: While you have stacks of Untold Greed, Orbs of Power and Elemental pickups provide more of their respective energy, and Strand Tangles deal increased damage. When your shields are broken, all stacks are converted into a fountain of Orbs of Power.

2270091246.name: Legacy's Oath (2 pc): Augmented Servos
2270091246.inGameDescription: Powered melees release an additional disorienting pulse when used to defeat a target.

2270091247.name: Legacy's Oath (4 pc): God-like Judgment
2270091247.inGameDescription: When your shields are broken by a combatant, or upon casting your Super, release a swarm of heat seeking micro-missiles.

2318783944.name: Pantheos Resplendent (2 pc): Well Prepared
2318783944.inGameDescription: Picking up ammo grants Armor Charge. Grants a bonus to Health stat per Armor Charge you have.

2318783945.name: Pantheos Resplendent (4 pc): Down the Line
2318783945.inGameDescription: Sustained damage on minibosses, Champions, and bosses increases weapon damage versus base and powerful combatants. Weapon final blows consume one stack each.

2433863522.name: Last Discipline (4 pc): Power Loader
2433863522.inGameDescription: Picking up an Orb of Power grants Special ammo progress.

2433863523.name: Last Discipline (2 pc): Terminal Velocity
2433863523.inGameDescription: Final blows with primary ammo weapons grant your primary ammo weapons temporarily increased reload speed.

2458353886.name: Techeun's Regalia (4 pc): Truth to Power
2458353886.inGameDescription: Gain increasing damage resistance when you deal damage or land final blows. Finishers grant accelerated progress. At max stacks, the recharge rate of your abilities is also increased.

2458353887.name: Techeun's Regalia (2 pc): Queensfoil Rush
2458353887.inGameDescription: Gain a powerful overshield while performing your finisher. When you finish a target, release a slowing burst around you.

2513809220.name: Disaster Corps Set (4 pc): Magnificent Duty
2513809220.inGameDescription: When you reach critical health or heal an ally at critical health, Auto Rifles, Scout Rifles, and Sidearms gain a period of increased range, stability, and reload speed.

2513809221.name: Disaster Corps Set (2 pc): Pleas Heard
2513809221.inGameDescription: Reloading an Auto Rifle, Scout Rifle, or Sidearm after a final blow slowly restores health until you reenter combat.

2562518502.name: Cruel Electrum (2 pc): Primary Survivor
2562518502.inGameDescription: When an ally is defeated, Primary ammo weapons gain increased handling, reload speed, target acquisition, and reduced flinch. Bonus increases when multiple allies are dead at the same time or when you are running solo.

2562518503.name: Cruel Electrum (4 pc): Primary Phantom
2562518503.inGameDescription: Final blows with Primary ammo weapons remove you from radar for a short time. Drawing a weapon that does not use Primary ammo will immediately end this effect.

2613226185.name: Collective Demolition
2613226185.inGameDescription:
Collecting an Elemental pickup or destroying a Tangle grants this weapon a stacking period of improved grenade energy generation on hit. Throwing a Tangle provides additional time.

Elemental pickups include [Solar]Firesprites, [Void]Void Breaches, [Arc]Ionic Traces, [Stasis]Stasis Shards, and [Strand]Strand Tangles.

2657416818.name: Circuit (2 pc): Revving Up
2657416818.inGameDescription: Fast movement builds up a charge that gradually increases your health regeneration speed. Once you are Fully Revved, sprinting grants Speed Booster.

2657416819.name: Circuit (4 pc): Dielectric Drift
2657416819.inGameDescription: Sliding while Speed Booster is active jolts combatants in front of you.

2769443638.name: Luminopotent (4 pc): Shock and Clear
2769443638.inGameDescription: Final blows with Jolt or against jolted combatants create Ionic Traces.

2769443639.name: Luminopotent (2 pc): Ionic Overclock
2769443639.inGameDescription: While amplified, your Fusion Rifles, Linear Fusion Rifles, and Heat weapons gain increased handling, reload, and vent speeds.

2840280304.name: AION Adapter (4 pc): Reactive Shock
2840280304.inGameDescription: When Force Absorption is active, taking melee damage causes you to emit a disorienting burst once.

2840280305.name: AION Adapter (2 pc): Force Absorption
2840280305.inGameDescription: Final blows with a Rocket Launcher, Grenade Launcher, or micro-missile temporarily decrease incoming area-of-effect damage.

3004427454.name: First Ascent (2 pc): Stack 'Em Up
3004427454.inGameDescription: Defeating targets with unique elemental damage grants a stacking bonus to Transcendence energy gains while Transcendence is inactive.

3004427455.name: First Ascent (4 pc): Burn 'Em Down
3004427455.inGameDescription: While Transcendence is active, using your grenade ability consumes all stacks of Stack 'Em Up to grant an escalating amount of grenade energy.

3078673682.name: Smoke Jumper Set (2 pc): Ride Together, Die Together
3078673682.inGameDescription: When you pick up an Orb of Power, gain a brief period of rapidly decaying damage reduction.

3078673683.name: Smoke Jumper Set (4 pc): Too Old for This
3078673683.inGameDescription: Defeating a powerful combatant with a finisher grants you Special ammo progress and replenishes a small amount of health.

3091068916.name: Per Audacia (2 pc): Primary Chain
3091068916.inGameDescription: Primary ammo weapon final blows grant a stacking bonus to mobility and Primary weapon range and handling until you are defeated.

3091068917.name: Per Audacia (4 pc): Sublime Transit
3091068917.inGameDescription: Increases mobility and grants enhanced sprint speed and slide distance.

3157066724.name: Iron Panoply Set (2 pc): Vigilant Watch
3157066724.inGameDescription: As your health gets lower, your weapons gain increased stability and handling. Weapon final blows while your shields are depleted heal you.

3157066725.name: Iron Panoply Set (4 pc): Iron Conviction
3157066725.inGameDescription: When your shields become broken, you gain increased ammo generation, flinch resistance, and damage resistance against nearby combatants for a short time. Final blows extend this effect.

3160370590.name: New Demotic (4 pc): Martingale
3160370590.inGameDescription: Your weapons gain a temporary increase to handling and aim-down-sights speed when an ally is defeated or you revive an ally.

3160370591.name: New Demotic (2 pc): Paroli
3160370591.inGameDescription: Primary ammo weapons gain a bonus to flinch resistance after sliding.

3376007202.name: Wayward Psyche Set (4 pc): Superluminal Motion
3376007202.inGameDescription: After dealing damage with your Super, health and shields regenerate over time while you are in motion. Additional Super damage refreshes this effect.

3376007203.name: Wayward Psyche Set (2 pc): Special Relativity
3376007203.inGameDescription: Picking up ammo reloads stowed Special weapons from reserves.

3390457360.name: Wild Anthem (4 pc): Suros Harmony
3390457360.inGameDescription: Reloading a weapon grants it a bonus to handling and reduces incoming flinch for a short time. Weapons with the SUROS Synergy Origin Trait are granted increased range instead.

3390457361.name: Wild Anthem (2 pc): Fanfare
3390457361.inGameDescription: Gain increased reload speed for the bottom half of your equipped weapon's magazine.

3432283356.name: Cyberserpent Null (4 pc): Bountiful Munitions
3432283356.inGameDescription: While Adrenal Rush is active, final blows grant Special Ammo progress. Final Blows against powerful combatants, Guardians, and Taken grants additional progress.

3432283357.name: Cyberserpent Null (2 pc): Adrenal Rush
3432283357.inGameDescription: Sprinting for a short time grants a period of improved reload speed and handling. Final blows extend this period.

3449901214.name: Dreambane (4 pc): Nightmarish Resilience
3449901214.inGameDescription: When you have Unstable Essence, rapid weapon damage or final blows heal you and begin health regeneration.

3449901215.name: Dreambane (2 pc): Nightmarish Power
3449901215.inGameDescription: Final blows to a challenging combatant or higher-ranked target grant Unstable Essence. When you have Unstable Essence, you receive grenade and melee stat bonuses.

3458982982.name: Ferropotent (2 pc): Rapid Repair
3458982982.inGameDescription: When your shields begin to regenerate, you gain flinch resistance and damage resistance for a short time.

3458982983.name: Ferropotent (4 pc): Built from Scratch
3458982983.inGameDescription: While your reserves are low, combatant final blows with weapons provide additional ammo progress based on their ammo type.  Primary ammo weapons boost Special ammo progress, and Special ammo weapons boost Heavy ammo progress.

3575602896.name: Iron Battalion Set (2 pc): Primary Honing
3575602896.inGameDescription: Increases handling and reload speed for Primary ammo weapons. Primary ammo weapons gain increased damage against non-boss combatants based on your Weapons stat.

3575602897.name: Iron Battalion Set (4 pc): Supercyclical
3575602897.inGameDescription: Final blows while your Super is active refund Super energy when it ends.

3599123168.name: Dark Age (4 pc): Healing Initiative
3599123168.inGameDescription: While you have Initiative, using your class ability creates a stationary healing aura. The aura gains increased healing based on the number of Initiative stacks.

3599123169.name: Dark Age (2 pc): Taking Initiative
3599123169.inGameDescription: Hitting combatants with melee attacks or Sword strikes grants a stack of Initiative, giving bonus handling and reload. Stacks decay slowly over time.

3657900810.name: Great Hunt (4 pc): Taken Armaments
3657900810.inGameDescription: Grenade final blows grant additional Heavy ammo progress.

3657900811.name: Great Hunt (2 pc): Taken Barrier
3657900811.inGameDescription: Grenade final blows temporarily reduce incoming damage.

3684445958.name: Collective Pugilism
3684445958.inGameDescription:
Collecting an Elemental pickup or destroying a Tangle grants this weapon a stacking period of improved melee energy generation on hit. Throwing a Tangle provides additional time.

Elemental pickups include [Solar]Firesprites, [Void]Void Breaches, [Arc]Ionic Traces, [Stasis]Stasis Shards, and [Strand]Strand Tangles.

3872620150.name: Crota's Memory (2 pc): Cursed Fist
3872620150.inGameDescription: Melee final blows trigger a Cursed Thrall explosion.

3872620151.name: Crota's Memory (4 pc): Power of the Son
3872620151.inGameDescription: Being in combat for a duration grants progressively more flinch resistance and damage resistance versus combatants.

3916960436.name: Swordmaster (2 pc): Balestra
3916960436.inGameDescription:
Damaging a target with a Sword, Glaive, or any melee attack exhausts them. 

Exhausted targets deal reduced outgoing damage.

3916960437.name: Swordmaster (4 pc): Stesso Tempo
3916960437.inGameDescription: Blocking attacks with a Sword or Glaive grants a short period of damage resistance against targets when you next drop your guard.

4019266109.name: Collective Demolition
4019266109.inGameDescription:
Collecting an Elemental pickup or destroying a Tangle grants this weapon a stacking period of grenade energy generation on hit. Throwing a Tangle provides additional time.

Elemental pickups include [Solar]Firesprites, [Void]Void Breaches, [Arc]Ionic Traces, [Stasis]Stasis Shards, and [Strand]Strand Tangles.

4048287940.name: Lustrous (2 pc): Photogalvanic
4048287940.inGameDescription: Receiving healing temporarily grants your Solar weapons increased flinch resistance, handling, and reload speed.

4048287941.name: Lustrous (4 pc): Cauterize
4048287941.inGameDescription: Rapid Solar final blows heal you.

4083289734.name: Eutechnology (4 pc): Techeun's Foresight
4083289734.inGameDescription: After collecting a Void breach, your next final blow with a Void weapon triggers a detonation. The detonation is more powerful if it is triggered quickly after collecting a Void breach.

4083289735.name: Eutechnology (2 pc): Gift of the Ley Lines
4083289735.inGameDescription: Rapidly defeating combatants with Void energy spawns a Void breach.

4110483280.name: Kentarch 3 (4 pc): Network Upload
4110483280.inGameDescription: Weapon final blows grant the wearer and nearby allies melee energy.

4110483281.name: Kentarch 3 (2 pc): Network Admin
4110483281.inGameDescription:
Being near allies creates a relay network that gives the wearer improved handling and reload speed. 

Being near other allied Network Admins additionally grants the wearer a bonus to Health stat.

4160419914.name: Wildwood (2 pc): Watchtower
4160419914.inGameDescription: Precision final blows while aiming down sights grant damage resistance until you stop aiming down sights.

4160419915.name: Wildwood (4 pc): Field Expertise
4160419915.inGameDescription:
Precision final blows with any weapon grant a stacking bonus to reload speed, target acquisition, and weapon damage against non-boss combatants for a short duration.

Weapon final blows with non-precision direct hits end this effect early.

4261390988.name: Triumphal Anthem (2 pc): Scoot to Loot
4261390988.inGameDescription: Sliding collects nearby ammo and temporarily grants enhanced reload speed and handling to your weapons.

4261390989.name: Triumphal Anthem (4 pc): Shoot to Scoot

4275454258.inGameDescription: Defeating an unraveled combatant grants grenade ability energy. If you have max grenade energy, you are granted Special ammo meter progress instead.

4275454259.inGameDescription: Activating your grenade or the Nanotech Tracer Missiles Origin Trait provides stacking resistance to incoming damage at point-blank range.

4287944422.name: Seventh Seraph (2 pc): Rasputin's Wrath
4287944422.inGameDescription: Final blows with area-of-effect damage, Solar abilities, Seventh Seraph weapons, or IKELOS weapons grant Warmind Charges. Each stack of Warmind Charge increases your Weapons and Grenade stats.

4287944423.name: Seventh Seraph (4 pc): Rasputin's Reprisal
4287944423.inGameDescription:
While you have Warmind Charges, defeating powerful combatants, destroying a construct, or destroying a Tangle releases a Solar detonation that damages combatants and heals allies.

Constructs include barricades, turrets, Stasis crystals, and other objects created in the field.
